request.title: Over the waterfall
request.prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. Scene: a blizzard over the Muttonham falls. A great wooden ship packed with Frost Wardens in white armour, frost giants and frost trolls tips over the edge of a thundering waterfall; at the stern Nate rises into the air, grinning, coat flapping. Cliffs, a stone bridge and the town in the distance. Spectacular. Characters: Nate: a human warlock and pirate with long wild red hair and stubble, in a dark navy captain's coat over a loose white shirt.

references.role: Character appearance reference for Nate. Preserve the face, hair, build, colours and outfit shown; ignore the background, base and any interface elements.

request.alt: A ship full of Frost Wardens and giants plunges over a waterfall in a blizzard as Nate flies clear, grinning.
